title: Creatures made of wind
subject: Strandbeest
context: They have no muscles or hearts, yet watching them walk, it's remarkably easy to forget that they're machines. Jansen's wind-powered sculptures occupy a fascinating space between engineering, sculpture and artificial life.

sources.label: Linda Hall Library: Scientist of the Day, Theo Jansen (2024)

related.relation: also works with the coast, like
related.note: Both bring art and engineering to the beach: walking sculptures on the North Sea shore, and proposed seaweed-concrete blocks for Florida's.

editorialNotes: The official site renders only with JavaScript (a fetch returns a notice); content verified through the Linda Hall Library. Jansen, born 1948, Dutch; Strandbeests since 1990, mostly PVC pipe, driven by the wind.
